name: Classic Mode
version: 0.0.1-foundation (5 Nov 2026: settings file and shot folder only; no camera code yet)
author: Project Silent
description: Fixed-camera mode in the spirit of the 2001 game: authored tracking cameras, rails and reveals instead of the over-the-shoulder camera. Toggle with F7 in game or here. This build installs only the settings file and the shot folder - the loader DLL comes with the first camera build.
